runs.name: published-0.2.6053-forced-paint-hold
runs.failure: Treat a native fade-in as rendering in progress.

nativePinRegression.diagnosis: The matching native widget had complete source, positive geometry and native isVisible=true but computed opacity=0 during fade-in. The command classified it as absent and its retry hid it just as its first frame became visible, restarting the animation.
nativePinRegression.fix: Only for a matching, natively visible, non-hidden, laid-out source with fade-in, report rendering-pending until opacity becomes visible. Existing URI/cursor/deadline and ordinary lifecycle visibility guards remain.
nativePinRegression.test: Hold an actual native source transparent for 900ms after one intentionally empty provider response; require successful concurrent Pin and zero refires during the hold.

visualInspection.method: Electron CDP keyboard/pointer input; viewport and document focus emulation
visualInspection.findings: No introduced layout or state defects observed in the inspected captures.

limitations: Scan measurements use actual generated functions with native timers and mock page/session. They exclude DOM, debounce, providers, transport and Quick Pick latency.
No whole-process CPU/GPU, RSS or whole-UI latency claims.
Other OS/VS Code versions, themes, screen readers, mobile/tablet devices and physical OS focus routing were not tested.
